relations_content: The Department of Public Relations and Media was established following the decree issued by the University President in 2024, in accordance with defined objectives to serve as a reflection of the university's various activities. Since that date, it has acted as a liaison between the university and various institutions...
faculties_section:
The university offers a diverse range of academic programs across various fields, awarding training certificates, technical diplomas, general bachelor's degrees, honors bachelor's degrees, higher diplomas, master's degrees (by research, by coursework, or by research and coursework), and doctoral degrees (by coursework and research, or by research only).
 Academic programs are provided across the university's faculties, which include: the Faculty of Graduate Studies, Faculty of Business Studies, Faculty of Engineering and Architecture, Faculty of Nursing Sciences, Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology, Faculty of Information Systems, and Faculty of Law.
